recentItems.title: ‘Anak’ FULL MOVIE (Digitally Restored) | Vilma Santos, Claudine Barretto
recentItems.description:
In this restored and remastered film, Josie (Vilma Santos) worked for many years as a domestic helper in Hongkong to provide for her family. She returns home only to be coldly greeted by her children, with her eldest Carla (Claudine Barretto) being the harshest. As Carl spirals out of control, will Josie be able to reconnect with her family and save her daughter from ruining her life? Released in 2000 and directed by Rory Quintos.

Starring Vilma Santos, Claudine Barretto, Baron Geisler, and Joel Torre.

recentItems.title: ‘One More Chance’ FULL MOVIE | Bea Alonzo, John Lloyd Cruz
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: ‘Four Sisters and a Wedding’ FULL MOVIE | Toni Gonzaga, Bea Alonzo, Shaina Magdayao, Angel Locsin
recentItems.description:
Sisters Teddie (Toni Gonzaga), Bobbie (Bea Alonzo), Alex (Angel Locsin) and Gabbie (Shaina Magdayao) get the shock of their lives when their brother CJ (Enchong Dee) announces he’s getting married. Their plans to stop the wedding are made complicated by their hidden resentments as issues between the sisters resurface. Released in 2013 and directed by Cathy Garcia-Sampana.

Starring Toni Gonzaga, Bea Alonzo, Shaina Magdayao, Angel Locsin, and Enchong Dee.

recentItems.title: ‘Himala’ FULL MOVIE (Digitally Restored) | Nora Aunor
recentItems.description:
A restored and remastered film. Elsa (Nora Aunor), a normal girl in the town of Cupang, gains healing powers after witnessing an apparition of the Virgin Mary, bringing miracles with corresponding consequences in the neighborhood. Released in 1982 and directed by Ishmael Bernal.

Starring Nora Aunor, Spanky Manika, Gigi Duenas, Laura Centeno, and Vangie Labalan.
